title.narrative: Access to life-saving essential and emergency healthcare services to Cyclone Mocha affected people

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide life-saving essential and emergency healthcare services to Cyclone Mocha affected people. This WHO project provides essential basic and emergency care, including emergency obstetric and neonatal care, clinical management of Gender Based Violence cases, medicines and related medical equipment and improves access for people affected from Cyclone Mocha to help reduce avoidable, excess morbidity, mortality and disability. The project supports 50,000 people, including 20,000 women, 24,000 children, 6,000 men and including 6,500 persons with disabilities.
